A '''junior officer''' was stationed aboard the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|''Nebulon-B'' escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. When part of the ship's crew mutinied, the junior officer remained loyal to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]] and was placed in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and blasted into space.<ref name="FOP" />
